description: Create a GolfCore Premium checkout link for the signed-in golfer. Premium adds the caddie in this connector and the GolfCore app, plus green contour maps, live wind and offline course packs. Plans: day_pass, $3 for 24 hours of Premium, one charge and no subscription, the popular choice for a golfer on the course today; plus_monthly, $10 a month; and plus_yearly, $100 a year. A first-time subscriber pays half for the first month or first year. Ask the golfer which plan they want before calling. R
